name: Apple Music with Timbre
subtitle: Apple Music web radio and Timbre audio test
description: Version 0.3.0 opens Apple Music free radio in a web player and tests whether Web Audio can reach its signal. Web EQ activates only after samples are detected. Safari playback is confirmed, but app web playback and audible EQ need device verification. Native MusicKit remains experimental; imported unprotected audio retains Timbre EQ.
